method.primary_unit: one model output for one target sentence
method.correct_definition: No clearly unsupported directional claim, all required reference directions present, and no unresolved reference boundary. E/T or referent-only flags do not change primary emotion/grounding status.
method.incorrect_definition: At least one clearly unsupported directional claim or missing required direction; even when another claim supplies the same correct emotion direction.
method.borderline_definition: Reviewed, but the frozen codebook/source does not settle an applicability/attribution boundary; neither silently correct nor incorrect.
method.invalid_definition: Existing mechanical validation failed; source errors preserved and excluded from semantic denominators.
method.not_run_definition: No collected output; never treated as empty.
method.reference_policy: Existing v0.5 broad place-level desirability is allowed; event gate ineligibility does not automatically make every scoped event claim semantically wrong. Price/product/exhibit facts are not automatically place atmosphere.
method.tag_flags_scope: Observed E/T and referent flags are separate diagnostics, not a comprehensive tag-accuracy metric.
